invariants.rationale: If a non-null object is returned, its name must equal the input name; otherwise, null is returned.
If a non-null object is returned, its name must not be null since a comparison was performed with name.equals(object.getName()).
The returned object should have a name equal to the provided name; using equals in both directions ensures symmetry and null safety based on previous checks.
If result is null, that is allowed; this reflects that returning null is an expected outcome if no match is found.
The method assumes that name is non-null to avoid NullPointerException when calling name.equals(...).
